description: KY-023 joystick: ADC1 IN0 (PA0, VRx) and IN1 (PA1, VRy) single conversions + SW on PB12 (pull-up), prints 'x=<raw> y=<raw> sw=<0|1>' every 100 ms on USART1
expect: 72 MHz, ADCCLK = PCLK2/6 = 12 MHz. ADC1 independent, single conversion, software start, right aligned; after HAL_ADCEx_Calibration_Start each report selects IN0 (PA0, analog) then IN1 (PA1, analog) as regular rank 1, sampling 55.5 cycles, start + poll + read. PB12 input with pull-up. USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1. Boot: 'KY-023 joystick: VRx PA0, VRy PA1, SW PB12\r\n'. Every 100 ms (first right after boot): 'x=<raw> y=<raw> sw=<0|1>\r\n' with raw = round(V / VDDA x 4095) and sw = 1 while PB12 is low. A KY-023 fed from 3.3 V reads about 2048 / 2048 at rest, 0 and 4095 at the stops.

circuit: USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)
PA0, PA1: 10k ohm pull-down to GND (tests/devices/sensors-firmware.test.ts wires a KY-023 joystick instead)

boot.USART1:
KY-023 joystick: VRx PA0, VRy PA1, SW PB12
x=0 y=0 sw=0
